<?php
// =========================================================================
// app/Http/Controllers/LangueController.php: GET /language/fr, GET /language/en: the
// two buttons, FR and EN, on the navigation bar. Public route: Users must be able to
// change the language before logging in.
//
// The selection is stored in a cookie: with each subsequent request, the middleware
// FixerLangue reads it and sets the request language. Then you return to the page
// where we come from (see Example 22).
// =========================================================================

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Middleware\FixerLangue;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class LangueController
{
     // {code} is limited to the languages supported by the route (whereIn): /language/de returns a 404 page
    public function changer(Request $request, string $code): RedirectResponse
    {
         // one year: 60 * 24 * 365 minutes
        return redirect($this->pageDOrigine($request))->withCookie(cookie(
            FixerLangue::COOKIE, $code, 60 * 24 * 365, '/', null,
            config('rdvmedecins.cookie_secure'), true, false, 'lax'));
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // the previous page, based on the "Referer" header (HTTP) sent by the browser.
     // We only keep the path (/agenda?...): redirect to a
     // provided by the request would allow the user to be sent to a
     // different site (a vulnerability known as an “open redirect”).
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    private function pageDOrigine(Request $request): string
    {
        $referer = $request->headers->get('Referer');
        $url = $referer ? parse_url($referer) : false;
        $chemin = $url['path'] ?? '';
         // "//site.com/..." would be interpreted by the browser as a URL on a
         // AUTRE site: also rejected
        if (! isset($url['scheme']) || ! str_starts_with($chemin, '/') || str_starts_with($chemin, '//')
            || str_starts_with($chemin, '/langue/')) {
            return '/';
        }
        return isset($url['query']) ? "$chemin?{$url['query']}" : $chemin;
    }
}

The FR / EN buttons on the navigation bar: the language selection is stored in a cookie for one year (Example 22), after which the browser returns to the page it came from. The cookie is not encrypted (see [bootstrap/app.php]); it is [httpOnly]: the [JavaScript] on the page does not need to read it.

  • Lines 35–47: The previous page is specified by the header HTTP [Referer] that the browser sends with the request. This is data provided by the client and is therefore suspect: redirecting to a full URL from the request would allow an attacker to send the user to their own site via a link to [/langue/fr] with a fake [Referer] (the so-called *open redirect* vulnerability). Therefore, we retain only the path and parameters ([/agenda?idMedecin=1&...]), extracted by the function [parse_url] from [PHP], which splits a URL into its parts ([scheme], [host], [path], [query]...). A path starting with [//] is also rejected: a browser interprets [//site.com/page] as an address on another site. Finally, we cannot return to [/langue/...]: a loop.

docs.title: 11.17.3. app/Http/Controllers/AgendaController.php
docs.text:
<?php
// =========================================================================
// app/Http/Controllers/AgendaController.php: the calendar page: selection of a
// doctor and a date, that doctor’s schedule for that day, booking and cancellation
// appointment.
//
//    GE T /schedule?idMedecin=1&day=2026-09             -23 the page
//    GE T /agenda?idMedecin=1&day=2026-09-23&book=7     the same page, with the
//                                                           booking window
//                                                           for time slot 7 is open
//    POST /calendar/book                                   creates an appointment
//    POST /calendar/canc                                  el cancels an appointment
//
// The entire page is described by its URL: you can reload it, add it to
// bookmark, or use the browser’s “Back” button—without a single line of
// JavaScript.
//
// What everyone sees and can do:
//
//    | rol         e | displayed re           served slot           | Reserve | Cancel |
//   |---------------|-----------------------------------|--------------------|---------|
//    | ADMIN, DOCTOR | patient name                         | for     a patient | yes |
//                  |                                    |            | selected from list | |
//    | USER (patient)| “Reserved,” or SON name if it i s | for himself, if he| no (*) |
//                  | | his own            appointment          | does not already have an appointment| |
//                  |                                                         | | upcoming | |
//
//    (*) The patient cancels their appointment from their "My Account" page.
//
// CONFIDENTIALITÉ: For a patient, the names of the AUTRES patients are not
// simply hidden by the view—it is never passed to the view. The HTML sent
// to the browser therefore does not contain it, even if hidden (a simple "View Source"
// " would reveal it otherwise).
//
// No past reservations: the “Reserve” button only appears for
// today and the following days (and the business layer would reject it outright
// case).
//
// Security: all URL /calendar pages require an authenticated user (general
// general rule, see bootstrap/app.php); the [role] middleware for POST routes requires
// one of the listed roles (see routes/web.php).
// =========================================================================

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Domain\AgendaMedecinJour;
use App\Metier\Dates;
use App\Metier\MetierException;
use App\Models\Client;
use App\Models\Personne;
use App\Models\Role;
use App\Vues\AgendaVue;
use App\Vues\LigneAgenda;
use App\Vues\OptionVue;
use App\Vues\ReservationVue;
use App\Web\ApplicationModel;
use App\Web\Flash;
use App\Web\Message;
use App\Web\Outils;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class AgendaController
{
    public function __construct(private ApplicationModel $application)
    {
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // GET /agenda
     // The parameters of URL are read in raw format ($request->query), to distinguish a
     // ABSENT parameter (null) from a VIDE parameter (?idMedecin=).
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    public function afficher(Request $request): View
    {
        $erreur = null;
        $utilisateur = Outils::utilisateur();
        $droits = $this->droits();

         // the day: the day specified in URL if valid, otherwise today
        $jour = Dates::aujourdhui();
        $jourBrut = $request->query('jour');
        if ($jourBrut !== null) {
            $jourDemande = Outils::dateValide(is_string($jourBrut) ? $jourBrut : null);
            if ($jourDemande !== null) {
                $jour = $jourDemande;
            } else {
                $erreur = 'ERRORS.INVALID_DATE';
            }
        }
        $jourReservable = $jour->gte(Dates::aujourdhui());

         // the doctor: the one from URL; otherwise, for a logged-in doctor, the doctor themselves
        $idMedecinBrut = $request->query('idMedecin');
        $idMedecin = Outils::entierPositif($idMedecinBrut);
        if ($idMedecinBrut === null && $utilisateur->role === Role::DOCTOR) {
            $idMedecin = $this->application->getMedecinByUserId($utilisateur->userId)?->id;
        }

         // the drop-down list of doctors
        $medecins = $this->application->getAllMedecins()
            ->map(fn (Personne $m) => self::option($m, $m->id === $idMedecin))->all();

         // the calendar, if a doctor is selected (and the date is valid)
        $agenda = null;
        if ($idMedecin !== null && $erreur === null) {
            $agendaMedecin = $this->application->getAgendaMedecinJour($idMedecin, $jour);
            if ($agendaMedecin === null) {
                $erreur = 'ERRORS.DOCTOR_NOT_FOUND';
            } else {
                $agenda = $this->agendaVue($agendaMedecin, $droits, $jourReservable);
            }
        }

         // the booking window: only if the requested time slot is bookable
         // by this user. array_find: the first element that checks the
         // condition (null if there is none)
        $reservation = null;
        $idCreneau = Outils::entierPositif($request->query('reserver'));
        if ($agenda !== null && $idCreneau !== null) {
            $ligne = array_find($agenda->lignes,
                fn (LigneAgenda $l) => $l->idCreneau === $idCreneau && $l->reservable);
            if ($ligne !== null) {
                $reservation = new ReservationVue(
                    $ligne->idCreneau,
                    $ligne->horaire,
                    $droits['gestionnaire']
                        ? $this->application->getAllClients()->map(fn (Client $c) => self::option($c, false))->all()
                        : [],
                    $droits['patient']?->libelle());
            }
        }

        return view('agenda', [
            'titrePage' => 'AGENDA.PAGE_TITLE',
            'erreur' => $erreur ? new Message($erreur) : null,
            'medecins' => $medecins,
            'idMedecin' => $idMedecin,
            'jour' => Outils::iso($jour),
            'agenda' => $agenda,
            'reservation' => $reservation,
             // the displayed calendar, without the reservation window
            'urlRetour' => $idMedecin !== null ? self::urlAgenda($idMedecin, $jour) : route('agenda'),
            'info' => $this->infoPatient($droits, $agenda),
        ]);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // POST /calendar/boo  k fields: idMedecin, day, idCreneau, idClient
    //
     // For a patient (USER), the field idClient is IGNORÉ: he always makes a reservation
     // for himself. Trusting a field sent by the browser
     // would allow a malicious patient to make a reservation in someone else’s name.
    //
     // "Post/Redirect/Get" pattern: regardless of the result, we do not generate
     // a page here—we display a flash message and redirect to the calendar
     // (see example 20).
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    public function reserver(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        [$idMedecin, $jour] = $this->agendaDemande($request);
        $idCreneau = Outils::entierPositif($request->input('idCreneau'));
        if ($idMedecin === null || $idCreneau === null) {
            abort(400);    // -> “Invalid Request” page (see bootstrap/app.php)
        }
        $utilisateur = Outils::utilisateur();

        if ($utilisateur->estPatient()) {
            $client = Outils::patientConnecte($this->application);
        } else {
            $idClient = Outils::entierPositif($request->input('idClient'));
            if ($idClient === null) {
                 // No patient selected: the booking window reopens
                Flash::erreur('ERRORS.CHOOSE_PATIENT');
                return redirect(self::urlAgenda($idMedecin, $jour, $idCreneau));
            }
            $client = $this->application->getClientById($idClient);
        }

        $creneau = $this->application->getCreneauById($idCreneau);
        if ($client === null) {
            Flash::erreur('ERRORS.PATIENT_NOT_FOUND');
        } elseif ($creneau === null || $creneau->id_medecin !== $idMedecin) {
            Flash::erreur('ERRORS.SLOT_NOT_FOUND');
        } else {
            try {
                 // the rules (not in the past, only one upcoming appointment per
                 // patient, available time slot) are verified by the business layer
                $this->application->ajouterRv($jour, $creneau, $client);
                Flash::succes('AGENDA.BOOKED');
            } catch (MetierException $e) {
                 // same rule, but a message to the second person when it is the
                 // patient themselves who is making the appointment (“You already have...” rather than
                 // “This patient…”). The other exceptions (true anomalies) are
                 // are not caught: 500 error.
                if ($e->cle === 'ERRORS.PATIENT_HAS_UPCOMING_APPOINTMENT' && $utilisateur->estPatient()) {
                    Flash::erreur('AGENDA.ALREADY_BOOKED_INFO');
                } else {
                    Flash::erreur($e->cle, $e->parametres);
                }
            }
        }
        return redirect(self::urlAgenda($idMedecin, $jour));
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // POST /agenda/canc  el fields: idRv, idMedecin, day
     // (a patient cancels SON an appointment from "My Account," not from here)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    public function annuler(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        [$idMedecin, $jour] = $this->agendaDemande($request);
        $idRv = Outils::entierPositif($request->input('idRv'));
        if ($idMedecin === null || $idRv === null) {
            abort(400);
        }
        $rv = $this->application->getRvById($idRv);
        if ($rv === null) {
             // already canceled (by someone else, or by double-clicking)
            Flash::erreur('ERRORS.APPOINTMENT_NOT_FOUND');
        } else {
            $this->application->supprimerRv($rv);
            Flash::succes('AGENDA.CANCELLED');
        }
        return redirect(self::urlAgenda($idMedecin, $jour));
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // Who is logged in, and what permissions do they have on this page?
        // administrator: ADMIN or DOCTOR;
        // patient: the logged-in client (role USER), otherwise null;
        // patientPeutReserver: a USER with no upcoming appointments.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    private function droits(): array
    {
        if (! Outils::utilisateur()->estPatient()) {
            return ['gestionnaire' => true, 'patient' => null, 'patientPeutReserver' => false];
        }
        $patient = Outils::patientConnecte($this->application);
        $rvAVenir = $this->application->getRvAVenirClient($patient->id);
        return ['gestionnaire' => false, 'patient' => $patient, 'patientPeutReserver' => $rvAVenir->isEmpty()];
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // the doctor’s calendar, formatted for display—and filtered according to permissions
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    private function agendaVue(AgendaMedecinJour $agendaMedecin, array $droits, bool $jourReservable): AgendaVue
    {
        $idMedecin = $agendaMedecin->medecin->id;
        $jour = $agendaMedecin->jour;
        $lignes = [];
        foreach ($agendaMedecin->creneauxMedecinJour as $cmj) {
            $creneau = $cmj->creneau;
            $rv = $cmj->rv;
            $libre = $rv === null;
             // the appointment for the connected patient?
            $moi = $rv !== null && $droits['patient'] !== null && $rv->id_client === $droits['patient']->id;
            $lignes[] = new LigneAgenda(
                idCreneau: $creneau->id,
                horaire: $creneau->horaire(),
                libre: $libre,
                 // LE privacy setting: a patient only sees the name of
                 // SON appointment; for others, null (the view displays “Reserved”)
                patient: $rv !== null && ($droits['gestionnaire'] || $moi) ? $rv->client->libelle() : null,
                moi: $moi,
                reservable: $libre && $jourReservable && ($droits['gestionnaire'] || $droits['patientPeutReserver']),
                urlReserver: self::urlAgenda($idMedecin, $jour, $creneau->id),
                idRv: $rv !== null && $droits['gestionnaire'] ? $rv->id : null);
        }
        return new AgendaVue($agendaMedecin->medecin->libelle(), Outils::formaterJour($jour), $lignes);
    }

     // ----------------------------------------------------------------- Utility functions

     // the hidden fields idMedecin / day in the forms POST; [null, null] if
     // are invalid
    private function agendaDemande(Request $request): array
    {
        $idMedecin = Outils::entierPositif($request->input('idMedecin'));
        $jour = Outils::dateValide(is_string($request->input('jour')) ? $request->input('jour') : null);
        return $idMedecin === null || $jour === null ? [null, null] : [$idMedecin, $jour];
    }

     // /calendar?idMedecin=1&day=2026-09-23[&reserver=7]: route() appends to the end of
     // the parameters that are not path parameters
    private static function urlAgenda(int $idMedecin, CarbonImmutable $jour, ?int $reserver = null): string
    {
        $parametres = ['idMedecin' => $idMedecin, 'jour' => Outils::iso($jour)];
        if ($reserver !== null) {
            $parametres['reserver'] = $reserver;
        }
        return route('agenda', $parametres);
    }

    private static function option(Personne $p, bool $selectionne): OptionVue
    {
        return new OptionVue($p->id, $p->libelle(), $selectionne);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // the informational message for a patient who already has an upcoming appointment
     // (which is why there is no “Book” button), or null. Not applicable if SON
     // the appointment appears in the displayed calendar (in blue): this is the case
     // after they’ve just booked it, in which case the message would be moved.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    private function infoPatient(array $droits, ?AgendaVue $agenda): ?string
    {
        if ($droits['patient'] === null || $droits['patientPeutReserver']) {
            return null;
        }
        $rvAffiche = $agenda !== null && array_any($agenda->lignes, fn (LigneAgenda $l) => $l->moi);
        return $rvAffiche ? null : 'AGENDA.ALREADY_BOOKED_INFO';
    }
}

The application’s main page. The header comment summarizes what each user sees and can do.

docs.title: 11.17.3.1. The URL elements on the page
docs.text: The entire page is described by its URL: [/agenda?idMedecin=1&jour=2026-09-26] displays Doctor 1’s schedule for that day; [&reserver=4] also opens the window for booking slot 4. You can reload the page, bookmark it, or use the browser’s Back button without a single line of [JavaScript]. The form at the top of the page (for selecting the doctor and the day) is a GET form (example 17): it reloads the page with new parameters. The appointment booking window is opened by a simple link and closed by a link to the same page without the [reserver] parameter.

docs.title: 11.17.3.2. GET /calendar
docs.text:
Lines 76–148:

  • the parameters for URL are read as-is ([$request->query('jour')]), without validation by [Laravel]: a missing parameter ([null]) is not an error (it defaults to “today” or “no doctor”); an invalid date is an error, displayed at the bottom of the page, without preventing the rest of the content from being displayed; a doctor or time slot number that is not a positive integer is simply ignored;
  • A connected patient who has not selected a doctor can view their schedule: the system searches for their doctor using their account ([getMedecinByUserId]). [?->id]: The null-safe operator returns [null] if the object is [null], instead of raising an error;
  • the drop-down list of doctors: each doctor becomes a [OptionVue]; [map(...)->all()] returns an array;
  • the calendar, formatted and filtered according to the user’s permissions ([agendaVue], below);
  • the booking window, only if the requested time slot is bookable by that user: a patient who attempts to generate the URL [&reserver=2] for a booked time slot would get nothing. [array_find] ([PHP] 8.4) returns the first element of an array that satisfies a condition, or [null]. The list of patients is provided only to the administrator and doctors; a patient receives only their own name;
  • the view receives its variables ([view('agenda', [...])], example 13), including [titrePage] and [erreur], which are read by the template.

docs.title: 11.17.3.3. POST /agenda/reserve
docs.text:
Lines 161–206:

  • The hidden fields in the appointment form (doctor, day, time slot) are checked; if invalid, it must be a manually created request: [abort(400)], the “invalid request” page;
  • For a patient, the field [idClient] is ignored: the patient always books for themselves ([Outils::patientConnecte]). Trusting a field sent by the browser would allow a malicious patient to make a reservation in someone else’s name. For the administrator and doctors, a patient must have been selected; otherwise, the reservation window reopens with a message;
  • the time slot must belong to the doctor listed on the page;
  • the business rules (not in the past, only one upcoming appointment, available time slot) are verified by the business logic layer. A [MetierException] becomes a flash error message. The same rejection, “one upcoming appointment,” is displayed to the second person on behalf of the patient themselves (“You already have…”). Any other exception is not intercepted: this is a true error (Page 500);
  • in all cases, the Post/Redirect/Get pattern (example 20) applies: a pop-up message and a redirect to the calendar.

docs.title: 11.17.3.4. POST /calendar/cancel
docs.text: Lines 212–228: Cancellation of an appointment by the administrator or a doctor (the [role:ADMIN,DOCTOR] middleware in the route). An appointment that no longer exists (already canceled by someone else, or due to a double-click) is not an exception: it’s simply a message.

docs.title: 11.17.3.5. Permissions, the formatted calendar, and utility functions
docs.text:
• lines 236–244: what the user is authorized to do on the page, in an associative array: is the user an administrator (ADMIN or DOCTOR)? a patient (and which one)? can this patient make a reservation (no upcoming appointments)?
  • Lines 249–273: the doctor’s schedule, converted into rows for the view. The key point regarding confidentiality is line 266: a patient sees only the name associated with their own appointment. For the others, the property [patient] is set to [null], and the view displays “Reserved.” The name is not hidden by the view: it is never passed to the view, and therefore does not appear in the page’s source code, where it would be easy to read it. The “Book” button is displayed for an available time slot, on a day that has not yet passed, to an administrator or a patient who can make a booking; the “Cancel” button is displayed only to administrators. The named arguments ([idCreneau: $creneau->id]) make the construction of an object with eight properties readable;
  • lines 288–295: the URL for a doctor’s schedule on a given day. [route('agenda', [...])] adds, at the end of URL, as query parameters, the values that are not path parameters: [/agenda?idMedecin=1&jour=2026-09-26];
  • lines 308–315: the message explaining to a patient why there is no “Book” button (they already have an upcoming appointment), unless that appointment is in the displayed calendar (immediately after booking it, the message would be moved). [array_any] ([PHP] 8.4): Does at least one element satisfy the condition?

docs.title: 11.17.4. app/Http/Controllers/PersonnesController.php
docs.text:
<?php
// =========================================================================
// app/Http/Controllers/PersonnesController.php: the management of doctors and that
// for clients (reserved for ADMIN) are IDENTIQUES: same list, same form,
// same rules. Rather than writing the same actions twice, we write them once
// time in this class ABSTRAITE; MedecinsController and ClientsController
// inherit from it and specify only what distinguishes them: the section name
// (doctors or clients), the translation keys, and the methods of
// which ApplicationModel to call. This results in the following for each one (see routes/web.php):
//
//    GE T /doctor                  s list
//    GE T /doctors/add            empty form
//    POST /doctors/add            create
//    GE T /doctors/{id}/edit      pre-filled form
//    POST /doctors/{id}/edit      edit
//    POST /doctors/{id}/delete     deletion
//
// (and the same URL under /clients). The views are also shared:
// resources/views/people/liste.blade.php and people/formulaire.blade.php.
//
// SÉCURITÉ: the [role:ADMIN] middleware is applied to the GROUPE routes of each
// section (see routes/web.php): it protects all of its actions—including those
// that might be added later.
// =========================================================================

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Requests\PersonneRequest;
use App\Metier\DonneesPersonne;
use App\Metier\MetierException;
use App\Models\Personne;
use App\Vues\ClesPersonnes;
use App\Web\ApplicationModel;
use App\Web\Flash;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\View\View;

abstract class PersonnesController
{
     // the form fields affected by each business “data entry” error (a
     // duplicate): they are highlighted in red, with the message at the bottom of the page
    public const CHAMPS_ERREURS_METIER = [
        'ERRORS.LOGIN_TAKEN' => ['login'],
        'ERRORS.DOCTOR_ALREADY_EXISTS' => ['prenom', 'nom'],
        'ERRORS.PATIENT_ALREADY_EXISTS' => ['prenom', 'nom'],
    ];

    public function __construct(protected ApplicationModel $application)
    {
    }

     // ---- what each type of person must provide

     // "doctors" or "clients": the beginning of the URL codes and street names
    abstract protected function section(): string;

    abstract protected function cles(): ClesPersonnes;

    abstract protected function lister(): Collection;

    abstract protected function trouver(int $id): ?Personne;

    abstract protected function creer(DonneesPersonne $donnees): Personne;

    abstract protected function mettreAJour(int $id, DonneesPersonne $donnees): Personne;

    abstract protected function effacer(int $id): void;

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
     // GET /doctors (or /clients)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    public function liste(): View
    {
        return view('personnes.liste', ['titrePage' => $this->cles()->titre, 'cles' => $this->cles(),
            'section' => $this->section(), 'personnes' => $this->lister()]);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
     // GET /doctors/add
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    public function formulaireAjout(): View
    {
        return $this->formulaire(null);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
     // POST /doctors/add
     // PersonneRequest has already validated the entry: an invalid entry does not occur
     // so far (Laravel has redirected back to the form with the errors)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    public function ajouter(PersonneRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        try {
            $personne = $this->creer($request->donnees());
        } catch (MetierException $e) {
            return $this->erreurMetier($e);
        }
        Flash::succes($this->cles()->ajoute, self::parametres($personne));
        return redirect()->route($this->section().'.liste');
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
     // GET /doctors/{id}/edit
     // {id} must consist of numbers (whereNumber, see routes/web.php):
     // /doctors/abc/edit does not correspond to any route (404 page)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    public function formulaireModification(int $id): View
    {
        $personne = $this->trouver($id) ?? abort(404);
        return $this->formulaire($personne);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
     // POST /doctors/{id}/edit
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    public function modifier(PersonneRequest $request, int $id): RedirectResponse
    {
        try {
            $personne = $this->mettreAJour($id, $request->donnees());
        } catch (MetierException $e) {
            return $this->erreurMetier($e);
        }
        Flash::succes($this->cles()->modifie, self::parametres($personne));
        return redirect()->route($this->section().'.liste');
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
     // POST /doctors/{id}/delete
     // (A confirmation prompt asking "Are you sure?" appears before the form is submitted,
     // see public/js/app.js)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    public function supprimer(int $id): RedirectResponse
    {
        $personne = $this->trouver($id);
        try {
            $this->effacer($id);
            Flash::succes($this->cles()->supprime, self::parametres($personne));
        } catch (MetierException $e) {
            Flash::erreur($e->cle, $e->parametres);
        }
        return redirect()->route($this->section().'.liste');
    }

     // ----------------------------------------------------------------- internal functions

     // $personne null: create form; otherwise: update form,
     // pre-filled with its values (unless the view has input to redisplay: old())
    private function formulaire(?Personne $personne): View
    {
        $creation = $personne === null;
        $cles = $this->cles();
        return view('personnes.formulaire', [
            'titrePage' => $creation ? $cles->ajouter : $cles->modifier,
            'creation' => $creation,
            'personne' => $personne,
            'action' => $creation ? route($this->section().'.ajouter')
                : route($this->section().'.modifier', ['id' => $personne->id]),
            'urlListe' => route($this->section().'.liste'),
        ]);
    }

     // a business rule rejected the save: return to the form (back), with
     // the user’s input (withInput, excluding passwords), the error message
     // the business layer (at the bottom of the page), and the relevant fields, if any,
     // highlighted in red so the user can immediately see what to correct
    private function erreurMetier(MetierException $e): RedirectResponse
    {
        Flash::erreur($e->cle, $e->parametres);
        if (in_array($e->cle, ['ERRORS.DOCTOR_NOT_FOUND', 'ERRORS.PATIENT_NOT_FOUND'], true)) {
             // deleted in the meantime by another ADMIN: return to the list
            return redirect()->route($this->section().'.liste');
        }
        return back()->withInput(request()->except('password'))
            ->with('champsInvalides', self::CHAMPS_ERREURS_METIER[$e->cle] ?? []);
    }

     // :name and :login for the "added / modified / deleted" messages
    private static function parametres(?Personne $personne): array
    {
        return $personne === null ? ['nom' => '', 'login' => '']
            : ['nom' => "{$personne->prenom} {$personne->nom}", 'login' => $personne->compte?->login ?? ''];
    }
}

The management of doctors and clients is identical: same list, same form, same rules. The actions are written once, in an abstract class; [MedecinsController] and [ClientsController] inherit from it. Each must provide what sets it apart: this is the role of the abstract methods in lines 56–68, declared without code; a child class that does not implement them would be rejected by [PHP]. This is the design pattern known as the “template method”: the parent class defines the algorithm, while the child classes provide the details.

  • lines 43–47: the fields affected by each business-logic input error: a duplicate username affects the “login” field; a name conflict affects the “first name” and “last name” fields. These fields will be highlighted in red;
  • Lines 73–77: the list. The view is common to both sections: it receives the translation keys for the section ([cles]) and its name ([section]), which are used to generate the URL ([route("$section.ajout")]);
  • lines 92–101: the addition. The entry has already been validated by [PersonneRequest]: an invalid entry does not reach this point ([Laravel] redirected the browser back to the form, along with the errors). That leaves the business logic layer, which may reject the save (due to a namesake or a login already in use); otherwise, a success message appears and the user is returned to the list (schema PRG);
  • lines 108–112: the update form for an existing user: [?? abort(404)] ([abort] throws an exception: it is an expression, usable to the right of [??]);
  • lines 117–126: the update; the ID comes from the path of URL ([{id}]), the form data;
  • lines 133–143: the deletion. The form requested confirmation in the browser (example 21). The person is retrieved before deletion for the success message (“Doctor Paul TATOU has been deleted.”);
  • lines 149–161: the form, for creation ([$personne] equals [null]) or modification. The view receives the person and displays their values—except after a rejection, in which case it redisplays the entered data ([old], example 19);
  • lines 167–176: The business layer rejected the write operation. If the person has been deleted in the meantime (by another administrator): return to the list. Otherwise, return to the form ([back()], the previous page, example 19), as in the case of an input error: the entry to be redisplayed ([withInput], without the password), the message from the business layer (a pop-up error message, displayed at the bottom of the page), and the fields to be highlighted in red ([with('champsInvalides', ...)], a pop-up data value read by the view). [request()]: the current query, accessible everywhere;
  • lines 179–183: the parameters [:nom] and [:login] from the success messages.

docs.title: 11.17.6. app/Http/Controllers/InscriptionController.php
docs.text:
<?php
// =========================================================================
// app/Http/Controllers/InscriptionController.php: "Create a customer account": a
// A patient who does not yet have an account creates one themselves. Routes PUBLIQUES (we do not
// do not yet have an account, by definition):
//
//    POST /registration/acc  ess "Create a customer account" button on the
//                              authentication page: verifies the CAPTCHA from CETTE
//                              page, then opens the form
//    GE T /registrat        ion the form
//    POST /registrati        on creates the account, then returns to the login page
//
// The flow is protected against bots by the UN CAPTCHA on the
// authentication page:
//    1. The "Create a Customer Account" button sends the login form to
//       /registration/access; if the CAPTCHA is entered correctly, the server issues a
//       token (see app/Auth/PasseInscription.php);
//    2. Without a valid token, /registration redirects to the
//       authentication page (middleware VerifierPasseInscription);
//    3. The pass is consumed upon creation: solving a CAPTCHA allows
//       create a UN account;
//    4. Additionally, the number of accounts created per hour per address IP is limited
//       (see app/Auth/LimiteurTentatives.php).
//
// The account created is exactly the one that ADMIN would create from the "Clients" page
// (same business-layer method: ajouterClient), except that the patient
// CHOISIT their username and password (required, with confirmation).
// =========================================================================

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Auth\CaptchaService;
use App\Auth\LimiteurTentatives;
use App\Auth\PasseInscription;
use App\Http\Requests\InscriptionRequest;
use App\Metier\MetierException;
use App\Web\ApplicationModel;
use App\Web\Flash;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class InscriptionController
{
     // the fields that are not sent back to the browser JAMAIS
    private const MOTS_DE_PASSE = ['password', 'password_confirmation'];

    public function __construct(
        private ApplicationModel $application,
        private CaptchaService $captchas,
        private LimiteurTentatives $limiteur,
        private PasseInscription $passes,
    ) {
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // POST /registration/a  ccess fields: captchaId, captcha (those on the
     // authentication page; login and password, which are also sent, are ignored)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    public function acces(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $ip = (string) $request->ip();

         // too many accounts created recently from this address: no need to proceed further
        $minutes = $this->limiteur->minutesBlocageInscription($ip);
        if ($minutes > 0) {
            Flash::erreur('ERRORS.TOO_MANY_ACCOUNTS', ['minutes' => $minutes]);
            return redirect()->route('login');
        }

         // captcha missing or incorrect: return to the authentication page, with a
         // new image (one failure counts as a failed login attempt)
        if (! $this->captchas->verifier($request->input('captchaId'), $request->input('captcha'))) {
            $this->limiteur->echecLogin($ip, '');
            Flash::erreur('ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT');
            return redirect()->route('login');
        }

         // Correct CAPTCHA: issue the token and open the form
        return redirect()->route('inscription')
            ->withCookie(PasseInscription::cookie($this->passes->emettre()));
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // GET /registration (the token has been verified by the middleware)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    public function formulaire(): View
    {
        return view('inscription', ['titrePage' => 'INSCRIPTION.TITLE']);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // POST /registration. InscriptionRequest has already validated TOUTE the input (fields
     // and password confirmation): the user corrects all errors
     // all at once
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    public function creer(InscriptionRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $ip = (string) $request->ip();

         // 1. Have too many accounts been created recently from this address?
        $minutes = $this->limiteur->minutesBlocageInscription($ip);
        if ($minutes > 0) {
            Flash::erreur('ERRORS.TOO_MANY_ACCOUNTS', ['minutes' => $minutes]);
            return back()->withInput($request->except(self::MOTS_DE_PASSE));
        }

         // 2. Creation (customer + account USER, in a transaction)
        try {
            $this->application->ajouterClient($request->donnees());
        } catch (MetierException $e) {
             // username or first name + last name already taken: the pass remains valid
            Flash::erreur($e->cle, $e->parametres);
            return back()->withInput($request->except(self::MOTS_DE_PASSE))
                ->with('champsInvalides', PersonnesController::CHAMPS_ERREURS_METIER[$e->cle] ?? []);
        }

         // 3. The passcode has been used: it cannot be used to create a second account
        $this->passes->consommer($request->cookie(PasseInscription::COOKIE));
        $this->limiteur->inscriptionReussie($ip);

         // 4. Return to the login page; username is pre-filled
        $login = $request->input('login');
        Flash::succes('INSCRIPTION.DONE', ['login' => $login]);
        return redirect()->route('login', ['login' => $login])
            ->withCookie(PasseInscription::cookieEffacement());
    }
}

The patient creates a customer account themselves. The flow is protected by a CAPTCHA, the same one used on the login page.

  • Lines 60–82: The “Create a Customer Account” button on the login page submits the login form to this address (later, the view [login]). If too many accounts have been created recently from this address (IP), there is no need to proceed further. If the CAPTCHA is missing or incorrect: return to the login page with a new image and a message; the failure counts as a failed login attempt (with an empty username). If the CAPTCHA is correct: a token is stored in a cookie, and the user is redirected to the form;
  • lines 87–90: the form. The token has been verified by the route’s [passe.inscription] middleware;
  • Lines 97–127: Creation. [InscriptionRequest] has validated all the data entered, including the password confirmation: the user sees all their errors at once. The client and their account are created using the same business-layer method as for the administrator ([ajouterClient]); only the username and password are chosen by the patient. If a username or a homonym is already taken: return to the form, without using up the token. Creating an account consumes the token (one solved CAPTCHA equals one account), counts toward the hourly limit, and redirects to the login page with the username pre-filled ([route('login', ['login' => $login])] adds the parameter [?login=...]), along with a success message. The pass cookie is cleared.

The constant [MOTS_DE_PASSE] (line 46) lists the fields that should never be sent back to the browser: [back()->withInput()], without a parameter, would retain all input for the next form, including passwords; [$request->except([...])] submits the form without these fields. When [Laravel] returns to the form (due to a validation error), it automatically excludes the fields [password], [password_confirmation], and [current_password].

docs.title: 11.17.7. app/Http/Controllers/EspaceController.php
docs.text:
<?php
// =========================================================================
// app/Http/Controllers/EspaceController.php: the patient’s pages (role
// USER), the one they see immediately after logging in:
//
//    GE T /my-space               home page: [Gérer mon compte], [View a
//                                   calendar], and his upcoming appointment
//    POST /my-space/cancel        cancels the appointment SON
//    GE T /my-accou              nt account modification form
//    POST /my-accoun              t update
//    POST /my-account/delete      delete account (and its appointments)
//
// Golden rule for this controller: the patient in question is TOUJOURS, the one associated with the token
// (Tools::patientConnecte), never an identifier sent by the browser. A
// patient can therefore neither view, modify, nor cancel anything belonging to another
// belongs to another patient, even by crafting their own requests.
//
// Any modification or deletion of the account requires the password ACTUEL:
// Anyone who finds a session that has been left open cannot change the
// password nor delete the account. Incorrect attempts to enter the current password are
// counted as login failures (same limit).
// =========================================================================

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Auth\AuthService;
use App\Auth\LimiteurTentatives;
use App\Http\Requests\MonCompteRequest;
use App\Metier\MetierException;
use App\Models\Client;
use App\Models\Rv;
use App\Vues\RendezVousVue;
use App\Web\ApplicationModel;
use App\Web\Flash;
use App\Web\Message;
use App\Web\Outils;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class EspaceController
{
    public function __construct(
        private ApplicationModel $application,
        private AuthService $auth,
        private LimiteurTentatives $limiteur,
    ) {
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // GET /my-space
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    public function espace(): View
    {
        $patient = Outils::patientConnecte($this->application);
        $rendezVous = $this->application->getRvAVenirClient($patient->id)->map(fn (Rv $rv) => new RendezVousVue(
            $rv->id,
            Outils::formaterJour($rv->jour),
            $rv->creneau->horaire(),
            $rv->creneau->medecin->libelle(),
             // link to the doctor’s schedule for that day: the patient sees their name there
            route('agenda', ['idMedecin' => $rv->creneau->id_medecin, 'jour' => Outils::iso($rv->jour)])))
            ->all();
        return view('espace', ['titrePage' => 'ESPACE.TITLE', 'patient' => $patient->libelle(),
            'rendezVous' => $rendezVous]);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // POST /my-space/cancel   field: idRv
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    public function annulerRv(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $patient = Outils::patientConnecte($this->application);
        $idRv = Outils::entierPositif($request->input('idRv'));
        $rv = $idRv !== null ? $this->application->getRvById($idRv) : null;
         // a nonexistent appointment, and that of a AUTRE patient, receive the
         // same response: no information is disclosed about other patients’ appointments
        if ($rv === null || $rv->id_client !== $patient->id) {
            Flash::erreur('ERRORS.APPOINTMENT_NOT_FOUND');
        } else {
            $this->application->supprimerRv($rv);
            Flash::succes('AGENDA.CANCELLED');
        }
        return redirect()->route('espace');
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // GET /my-account: the form, pre-filled with the patient’s information
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    public function formulaireCompte(): View
    {
        $patient = Outils::patientConnecte($this->application);
        return view('compte', ['titrePage' => 'MON_COMPTE.TITLE', 'patient' => $patient]);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // POST /my-account (MonCompteRequest has validated the entry)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    public function modifierCompte(MonCompteRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $patient = Outils::patientConnecte($this->application);

         // the current password; incorrect: the message appears in SOUS the field and at the bottom of the page
        $erreur = $this->verifierMotDePasseActuel($request, $patient, $request->input('current_password'));
        if ($erreur !== null) {
            Flash::erreur($erreur->cle, $erreur->parametres);
            return back()->withInput($request->except(['password', 'password_confirmation', 'current_password']))
                ->withErrors(['current_password' => __($erreur->cle, $erreur->parametres)]);
        }

        try {
            $client = $this->application->modifierClient($patient->id, $request->donnees());
        } catch (MetierException $e) {
            Flash::erreur($e->cle, $e->parametres);
            return back()->withInput($request->except(['password', 'password_confirmation', 'current_password']))
                ->with('champsInvalides', PersonnesController::CHAMPS_ERREURS_METIER[$e->cle] ?? []);
        }
         // the login and display name are DANS the token: a new one is issued,
         // otherwise the navigation bar would retain the old name
        Flash::succes('MON_COMPTE.UPDATED');
        return redirect()->route('espace')->withCookie($this->auth->cookieJeton($client->compte));
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
     // POST /my-account/delete   field: current_password
     // The account, the client, and TOUS their appointments are all deleted, and then the
     // the patient is logged out.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    public function supprimerCompte(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $patient = Outils::patientConnecte($this->application);
        $erreur = $this->verifierMotDePasseActuel($request, $patient, $request->input('current_password'));
        if ($erreur !== null) {
            Flash::erreur($erreur->cle, $erreur->parametres);
            return redirect()->route('compte');
        }
        $this->application->supprimerClient($patient->id);
        Flash::succes('MON_COMPTE.DELETED');
        return redirect()->route('login')->withCookie(AuthService::cookieEffacement());
    }

     // ----------------------------------------------------------------- internal functions

     // null if the current password is correct; otherwise, the error message
    private function verifierMotDePasseActuel(Request $request, Client $patient, ?string $motDePasse): ?Message
    {
        $ip = (string) $request->ip();
        $login = $patient->compte->login;
        $minutes = $this->limiteur->minutesBlocageLogin($ip, $login);
        if ($minutes > 0) {
            return new Message('ERRORS.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS', ['minutes' => $minutes]);
        }
        if (! $motDePasse || $this->auth->valider($login, $motDePasse) === null) {
            $this->limiteur->echecLogin($ip, $login);
            return new Message('ERRORS.WRONG_CURRENT_PASSWORD');
        }
        return null;
    }
}

The patient’s personal pages. The golden rule for this controller: the patient in question is always the one associated with the token ([Outils::patientConnecte]), never an identifier sent by the browser. A patient cannot therefore view, modify, or cancel information belonging to another patient, even if they construct their own requests.

  • lines 53–66: My Space: the patient’s name and their upcoming appointments, formatted ([RendezVousVue]), each with a link to the doctor’s schedule for that day;
  • lines 71–85: Canceling the patient’s appointment. A nonexistent appointment and another patient’s appointment both receive the same response: no information about other patients’ appointments is disclosed (not even their existence);
  • lines 90–94: the “Manage My Account” form, pre-filled with the patient’s information;
  • lines 99–122: the modification. Any modification requires the current password: someone who found a session left open would be unable to change the password or do anything else. An incorrect current password: returns to the form, with a message below the field ([withErrors] adds an input error, as if validation had detected it) and at the bottom of the page (flash message). After the edit, a new token is generated: the login and display name are included in the token; otherwise, the navigation bar would retain the old name until the next login;
  • lines 129–140: Deletion of the account, the client, and all their appointments, using the same business-logic method as for the administrator. The current password is required; the patient is then logged out (token cookie cleared);
  • lines 145–158: verification of the current password. This is subject to the attempt limiter, just like a login: without this, someone with an open session could try thousands of passwords via the “Manage My Account” form and discover the correct one.

docs.title: 11.18. The Views
docs.text: The views [Blade] in the folder [resources/views]: a template, fragments, components, and pages.

docs.title: 11.18.1.1. resources/views/layout.blade.php
docs.text:
<!doctype html>
{{-- =========================================================================
     resources/views/layout.blade.php
     -------------------------------------------------------------------------
     Le gabarit COMMUN à toutes les pages (cf. exemple 15) : chaque page
     (agenda.blade.php, login.blade.php...) l'ÉTEND (@extends) et remplit sa
     section [contenu].

     Blade ÉCHAPPE tout ce qu'il affiche avec {{ ... }} (les caractères < > & " '
     deviennent < >...) : protection contre l'injection de HTML via un nom
     saisi, par exemple. Pour insérer du HTML tel quel, il faut le demander
     explicitement ({!! ... !!}, cf. components/captcha.blade.php).

     Messages : un succès s'affiche en HAUT de la page, une erreur en BAS, sur fond
     rose léger (fragment erreurs).

     Le gabarit partage les variables de la page : [titrePage] (la clé du titre de
     la page, transmise par l'action) ; [langue] et [utilisateur], ajoutés à toutes
     les vues par AppServiceProvider.
     ========================================================================= --}}
<html lang="{{ $langue }}">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  {{-- __($cle) : la traduction d'une clé ; ici, la clé est une VARIABLE --}}
  <title>{{ __($titrePage) }} - {{ __('APP.TITLE') }}</title>
  {{-- asset() : l'URL d'un fichier du dossier public --}}
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="{{ asset('lib/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css') }}">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="{{ asset('css/styles.css') }}">
</head>
<body>
  <div class="container py-4">
    @include('fragments.navbar')
    @include('fragments.succes')
    <main>
      @yield('contenu')
    </main>
    @include('fragments.erreurs')
  </div>
  {{-- la fenêtre "Êtes-vous sûr ?", cachée tant qu'on n'en a pas besoin --}}
  @include('fragments.confirmation')
  <script src="{{ asset('js/app.js') }}"></script>
</body>
</html>

The template common to all pages (Example 15): each page extends it ([@extends('layout')]) and fills in its [contenu] section (line 36).

  • line 21: the page’s language, [fr] or [en], provided to all views by the view composer [AppServiceProvider];
  • line 26: the page title, translated: [__($titrePage)] translates the key contained in the variable [$titrePage], which each action passes to its view;
  • lines 28–29: the function [asset] renders the URL from a file in the [public] folder (Example 15);
  • lines 33–38: the navigation bar, the success messages at the top of the page, the page content, and the error area at the bottom of the page. These fragments are inserted by [@include] (Example 15): they access the page’s variables;
  • line 41: the “Are you sure?” window, which is hidden until needed, and the script that displays it.

[Blade] escapes everything it displays using [{{ ... }}] (Example 14): A name entered that contains HTML ([<script>]) is displayed as-is, without being interpreted. This prevents HTML (XSS) from being injected effortlessly into all pages.

docs.title: 11.18.1.2. resources/views/fragments/navbar.blade.php
docs.text:
{{-- =========================================================================
     resources/views/fragments/navbar.blade.php - la barre de navigation.

     Titre, FR/EN, rôle, nom, déconnexion - et un menu dont les entrées dépendent
     du rôle : "Médecins" et "Clients" n'apparaissent que pour l'ADMIN. Ce n'est
     qu'un confort d'affichage : la vraie protection, ce sont les middlewares des
     routes (un USER qui tape /medecins à la main obtient une page 403). Un patient
     (USER) a en plus son menu "Mon espace".

     Le menu de la page courante est mis en évidence (classe "active") :
     request()->is('agenda*') est vrai si le chemin de l'URL commence par "agenda".
     Les entrées du menu : un tableau [URL, clé du libellé, motif des chemins pour
     lesquels l'entrée est active], parcouru par @foreach.
     ========================================================================= --}}
@php
  $menu = [];
  if ($utilisateur) {
      if ($utilisateur->estPatient()) {
           // active for /my-space ET /my-account
          $menu[] = [route('espace'), 'APP.MENU_MY_SPACE', 'mon-*'];
      }
      $menu[] = [route('agenda'), 'APP.MENU_AGENDA', 'agenda*'];
      if ($utilisateur->estAdmin()) {
          $menu[] = [route('medecins.liste'), 'APP.MENU_DOCTORS', 'medecins*'];
          $menu[] = [route('clients.liste'), 'APP.MENU_PATIENTS', 'clients*'];
      }
  }
@endphp
<nav class="navbar navbar-expand-sm navbar-dark bg-primary rounded mb-4 px-3">
  <span class="navbar-brand mb-0">{{ __('APP.TITLE') }}</span>

  <ul class="navbar-nav me-auto">
    @foreach ($menu as [$href, $cle, $motif])
    <li class="nav-item">
      {{-- @class : les classes dont la condition est vraie --}}
      <a @class(['nav-link', 'active' => request()->is($motif)]) href="{{ $href }}">{{ __($cle) }}</a>
    </li>
    @endforeach
  </ul>

  <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2">
    {{-- FR / EN : de simples liens (GET /langue/fr), la langue active en surbrillance --}}
    <div class="btn-group btn-group-sm" role="group" aria-label="FR / EN">
      @foreach (['fr', 'en'] as $code)
      <a class="btn {{ $langue === $code ? 'btn-light' : 'btn-outline-light' }}"
         href="{{ route('langue', ['code' => $code]) }}">{{ strtoupper($code) }}</a>
      @endforeach
    </div>

    @if ($utilisateur)
    <span class="badge text-bg-light text-primary">{{ $utilisateur->role->value }}</span>
    <span class="text-white">{{ $utilisateur->nom }}</span>
    {{-- la déconnexion est un POST : un formulaire réduit à son bouton (et au jeton anti-CSRF) --}}
    <form method="post" action="{{ route('logout') }}" class="m-0">
      @csrf
      <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-light">{{ __('APP.LOGOUT') }}</button>
    </form>
    @endif
  </div>
</nav>

The navigation bar. Menu items depend on the role: “My Account” for a patient, “Doctors” and “Clients” for the administrator. This is merely a convenience feature: the real protection comes from route middleware (a patient who manually types [/medecins] will receive a 403 page).

  • Lines 15–28: The menu is defined in a [@php] block (Example 14), an array of entries: URL (the label key) and the pattern of paths for which the entry is active. [request()->is('agenda*')] is true if the path of the requested URL matches the pattern ([*]: any sequence of characters). The “My Space” entry is active for [/mon-espace] and [/mon-compte] (pattern [mon-*]). This is borderline with the “no logic in views” rule: however, this logic applies only to the display and is used only here;
  • lines 33–38: [@foreach] breaks down each entry in the array into three variables (example 25). [@class([...])] (example 16) writes the [class] attribute with the classes for which the condition is true;
  • lines 44–47: the buttons FR / EN, simple links ([/langue/fr]), and the active language highlighted;
  • lines 50–58: for a logged-in user, their role ([$utilisateur->role->value]: the string representing the enumeration case), their name, and the logout button. Logout is a request POST: a form reduced to its button, with its anti-CSRF token ([@csrf], example 18).

docs.text:
{{-- =========================================================================
     resources/views/fragments/succes.blade.php - les messages de SUCCÈS déposés
     par l'action précédente (rendez-vous enregistré, médecin ajouté...), affichés
     une seule fois, en haut de la page (cf. app/Web/Flash.php). Un message flash
     d'ERREUR, lui, est affiché en bas de la page, par le fragment erreurs.

     Chaque message est un objet Message : __($message->cle, $message->parametres)
     est le texte de la clé, où :nom, :login... sont remplacés par leurs valeurs.

<div class="alert alert-success" role="status">{{ __($message->cle, $message->parametres) }}</div>

The success flash messages, set by the previous action ([Flash::succes]), are read from the session by [session('flash_succes', [])] (an empty list by default). Each is a [Message] object, translated here into the page’s language: [__($message->cle, $message->parametres)]. [role="status"]: A screen reader announces the message.

docs.title: 11.18.1.4. resources/views/fragments/erreurs.blade.php
docs.text:
{{-- =========================================================================
     resources/views/fragments/erreurs.blade.php - la zone d'erreur, en BAS de
     chaque page, sur fond rose léger (classe .zone-erreur, cf. public/css/styles.css).

     Elle regroupe les trois sources d'erreur possibles :
       - $erreur : l'erreur de la page affichée (date invalide, captcha mal
         recopié...), transmise par l'action ;
       - les messages flash d'erreur, déposés par l'action précédente avant une
         redirection (créneau déjà réservé, login déjà pris, suppression refusée...) ;
       - les erreurs de saisie ($errors, cf. exemple 19) : leurs messages sont
         affichés SOUS les champs ; ici, s'il n'y a pas d'autre message, une
         simple phrase « Le formulaire contient des erreurs. ».

     $erreur ?? null : la variable n'existe pas dans toutes les pages.
     role="alert" : un lecteur d'écran annonce le message dès l'affichage de la
     page, même s'il se trouve en bas.
     ========================================================================= --}}
@php
  $messages = session('flash_erreurs', []);
  if ($erreur ?? null) {
      array_unshift($messages, $erreur);
  }
  if (! $messages && $errors->any()) {
      $messages[] = new App\Web\Message('ERRORS.INVALID_FORM');
  }
@endphp
@if ($messages)
<div class="zone-erreur" role="alert">
  @foreach ($messages as $message)
  <div>{{ __($message->cle, $message->parametres) }}</div>
  @endforeach
</div>
@endif

The error area, at the bottom of each page, on a light pink background. It lists the three possible sources of error:

  • the error on the displayed page ([$erreur]), triggered by the action: an invalid date, a misspelled CAPTCHA, etc. [$erreur ?? null]: the variable does not exist on all pages; the [??] operator does not flag a nonexistent variable—it replaces it with [null];
  • flash error messages, triggered by the previous action (a time slot already reserved, a username already in use, etc.);
  • input errors ([$errors], example 19): their messages are displayed below the fields; here, if there are no other messages, a simple phrase appears: “The form contains errors.” On a long form, this lets the user know they need to go back up.

[array_unshift] adds an item to the beginning of a table. [role="alert"]: a screen reader announces the message as soon as the page is displayed, even if it is at the bottom. The field remains anchored at the bottom of the window when the page is long (see stylesheet, below).

{{-- =========================================================================

<div id="modale-confirmation" class="d-none">

      <div class="modal-content">

          <h5 class="modal-title" id="modale-confirmation-titre">{{ __('CONFIRMATION.TITLE') }}</h5>
          <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-action="non" aria-label="{{ __('BOOKING_DIALOG.CLOSE_ARIA') }}"></button>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-body">
          <p class="mb-0" id="modale-confirmation-message"></p>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-footer">
          {{-- "Non, revenir" plutôt qu'"Annuler" : la question est parfois
               « Annuler ce rendez-vous ? », et un bouton "Annuler" y serait ambigu --}}

          <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger" data-action="oui">{{ __('CONFIRMATION.YES') }}</button>

The “Are you sure?” modal window from Example 21, which replaces the browser’s [window.confirm()] dialog box: this dialog box does not format correctly, and its buttons remain in the browser’s language, not the page’s language. A single window for the entire page, initially hidden (class [d-none] derived from [Bootstrap]); its labels are translated by the server, just like the rest of the page. The script [public/js/app.js] displays it, places the message from the form to be confirmed inside it (its attribute [data-confirmation]), and submits the form if the user confirms. The “Cancel” button is labeled “No, go back” rather than “Cancel”: the question is sometimes “Cancel this appointment?”, and a “Cancel” button would be ambiguous in that context.

The calendar booking window. It uses the actual classes of a modal window from [Bootstrap] ([modal], [modal-backdrop]...), but made visible "hard-coded" ([show d-block]), rather than through [JavaScript] from [Bootstrap]: it is the server that decides to display it when URL contains [&reserver=...]. Closing it (using the X or the Cancel button) is equivalent to following a link to the same page without that parameter ([$urlRetour]).

  • lines 27–30: the anti-CSRF token, and what the server needs to know: the doctor, the day, and the time slot;
  • lines 34–47: a patient makes a reservation for themselves: their name, with no list to choose from (and the server ignores any [idClient] field anyway). The administrator and doctors select the patient from a list; [required] and [autofocus]: the browser requires a selection and places the cursor in the list.

docs.title: 11.18.2. The components
docs.text: Three anonymous components (Example 15), in the [resources/views/components] folder, used by the pages in the form of a [<x-nom>] tag.

docs.title: 11.18.2.1. resources/views/components/champ.blade.php
docs.text:
{{-- =========================================================================
     resources/views/components/champ.blade.php - un champ de saisie, son libellé,
     son message d'erreur ou son aide (cf. exemple 19) : <x-champ nom="login" ... />

     @props : les attributs attendus par le composant, avec leur valeur par défaut.
     La valeur affichée : old($nom, $valeur), la saisie à réafficher après un refus,
     sinon la valeur transmise. Un mot de passe n'est JAMAIS réaffiché.
     Le champ est encadré en rouge (classe Bootstrap is-invalid) s'il a une erreur
     de saisie ($errors), ou si une erreur métier le désigne (champsInvalides, cf.
     PersonnesController::erreurMetier) ; le message d'erreur remplace alors l'aide.
     ========================================================================= --}}
@props(['nom', 'libelle', 'type' => 'text', 'valeur' => null, 'aide' => null, 'max' => null,
        'autocomplete' => null, 'requis' => false])
@php
  $invalide = $errors->has($nom) || in_array($nom, session('champsInvalides', []), true);
@endphp
<label class="form-label" for="{{ $nom }}">{{ $libelle }}</label>
<input id="{{ $nom }}" name="{{ $nom }}" type="{{ $type }}" @class(['form-control', 'is-invalid' => $invalide])
       @if ($type !== 'password') value="{{ old($nom, $valeur) }}" @endif
       @if ($max) maxlength="{{ $max }}" @endif
       @if ($autocomplete) autocomplete="{{ $autocomplete }}" @endif
       @required($requis)>
@error($nom)
<div class="invalid-feedback">{{ $message }}</div>
@else
@if ($aide)
<div class="form-text">{{ $aide }}</div>
@endif
@enderror

An input field, with its label, error message, or tooltip: the [x-champ] component from Example 19, fully configured.

  • Line 12: the component’s attributes and their default values. On a page, [<x-champ nom="login" :libelle="__('PERSONNES.LOGIN_LABEL')" max="30" requis />]: an attribute preceded by [:] is assigned the value of an expression [PHP], while the others are assigned a string; an attribute with no value ([requis]) is set to [true];
  • lines 14–16: the field is invalid if it contains an input error ([$errors->has($nom)]), or if a business-layer error flags it as such: the list [champsInvalides], stored in the session by the action ([PersonnesController::erreurMetier]). A username that is already taken is not an input error (it has the correct format), but the user must see which field to correct;
  • lines 18–22: the displayed value is [old($nom, $valeur)]: the input to be redisplayed after a rejection; otherwise, the value transmitted by the page (that of the modified record). A password is never redisplayed: there is no [value] attribute for a [password] field. [@required($requis)] sets the Boolean attribute [required] if the condition is true;
  • lines 23–29: the field’s error message ([$message], example 19), otherwise any available help. The class [invalid-feedback] of [Bootstrap] is visible only after a field of class [is-invalid].

     :personne : la personne dont on affiche les valeurs (null pour un formulaire

     La liste des titres vient de la classe qui les valide (ChampsPersonneRequest).

@endphp

  <select id="titre" name="titre" @class(['form-select', 'is-invalid' => $errors->has('titre')])>
    @foreach (App\Http\Requests\ChampsPersonneRequest::TITRES as $titre)
    <option value="{{ $titre }}" @selected($titre === $titreChoisi)>{{ $titre }}</option>

Identity fields common to three forms: title (a list), first name, and last name (two [x-champ] fields: a component can use another component). The [personne] attribute is the person whose values are displayed, or [null] for an empty form. [$personne?->titre]: the null-safe operator returns [null] if [$personne] is null-safe. The list of titles comes from the class that validates them ([ChampsPersonneRequest::TITRES]): the rule is written once. [@selected(...)] writes the [selected] attribute of the selected option.

docs.title: 11.18.2.3. resources/views/components/captcha.blade.php
docs.text:
{{-- =========================================================================
     resources/views/components/captcha.blade.php - le captcha de la page
     d'authentification (cf. app/Auth/CaptchaService.php). Il protège à la fois la
     connexion et l'accès à la création de compte (bouton "Créer un compte client").

     {!! ... !!} : l'image SVG est insérée TELLE QUELLE dans la page, sans
     échappement. C'est sans danger ici parce que ce SVG est fabriqué par le
     serveur lui-même et ne contient rien qui vienne de l'utilisateur - on ne ferait
     JAMAIS cela avec une saisie.

     Le champ caché captchaId dit au serveur QUEL captcha vérifier ; la bonne
     réponse, elle, n'est jamais envoyée au navigateur. "Autre image" recharge
     simplement la page (url()->current() : l'URL de la page, sans ses paramètres).
     ========================================================================= --}}
@props(['captcha'])
<div class="mb-3">
  <label class="form-label" for="captcha">{{ __('CAPTCHA.LABEL') }}</label>
  <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3 mb-2">
    <div class="captcha-image" role="img" aria-label="{{ __('CAPTCHA.IMAGE_ALT') }}">{!! $captcha->svg !!}</div>
    <a class="small" href="{{ url()->current() }}">{{ __('CAPTCHA.NEW_IMAGE') }}</a>
  </div>
  <input type="hidden" name="captchaId" value="{{ $captcha->id }}">
  <input id="captcha" name="captcha" type="text" maxlength="10" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off"
         spellcheck="false" required class="form-control">
  <div class="form-text">{{ __('CAPTCHA.HELP') }}</div>
</div>

The CAPTCHA (example 27). [{!! $captcha->svg !!}] inserts the image SVG as-is, without escaping it; otherwise, the browser would display its code XML. This is safe here because this SVG is generated by the server and contains nothing provided by the user: we would never do this with user input. The hidden field [captchaId] tells the server which CAPTCHA to verify; the response itself is never sent to the browser. The “Another image” link reloads the page ([url()->current()]: the page’s URL, without its parameters), and thus the CAPTCHA.

docs.title: 11.18.3.1. resources/views/login.blade.php
docs.text:
{{-- =========================================================================
     resources/views/login.blade.php - le formulaire de connexion (cf.
     AuthController). Un <form> HTML ordinaire : le navigateur envoie lui-même
     login, mot de passe et réponse au captcha en POST /login, sans JavaScript. En
     cas d'échec, le serveur renvoie CETTE page, avec le login déjà saisi, un
     NOUVEAU captcha et l'erreur, affichée en bas de page par le gabarit.
     ========================================================================= --}}
@extends('layout')

@section('contenu')
<div class="row justify-content-center">
  <div class="col-sm-8 col-md-6 col-lg-5">
    <div class="card p-4">
      <h5 class="card-title mb-3">{{ __('LOGIN.TITLE') }}</h5>

      <form method="post" action="{{ route('login') }}">
        @csrf
        <div class="mb-3">
          <label class="form-label" for="login">{{ __('LOGIN.LOGIN_LABEL') }}</label>
          {{-- autofocus : un attribut booléen, écrit si la condition est vraie, omis
               sinon. Le curseur va au premier champ à remplir --}}
          <input id="login" name="login" type="text" class="form-control" autocomplete="username"
                 value="{{ $login }}" required @if ($login === '') autofocus @endif>
        </div>
        <div class="mb-3">
          <label class="form-label" for="password">{{ __('LOGIN.PASSWORD_LABEL') }}</label>
          <input id="password" name="password" type="password" class="form-control"
                 autocomplete="current-password" required @if ($login !== '') autofocus @endif>
        </div>

        <x-captcha :captcha="$captcha" />

        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary w-100">{{ __('LOGIN.SUBMIT') }}</button>

        {{-- pas encore de compte : un patient peut en créer un lui-même. Ce n'est
             PAS un simple lien : c'est un second bouton d'envoi de CE formulaire,
             qui part vers une autre adresse (formaction). Le serveur y vérifie le
             captcha ci-dessus avant d'ouvrir la page de création de compte (cf.
             InscriptionController). formnovalidate : le navigateur n'exige pas
             login et mot de passe (inutiles pour créer un compte). Entrée dans un
             champ déclenche toujours le PREMIER bouton du formulaire, "Se connecter". --}}
        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-outline-primary w-100 mt-3"
                formaction="{{ route('inscription.acces') }}" formnovalidate>{{ __('LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT') }}</button>
        <div class="form-text text-center">{{ __('LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT_HELP') }}</div>
      </form>

      <div class="text-muted small mt-3">
        <span>{{ __('LOGIN.DEMO_ACCOUNTS') }}</span>
        <ul class="mb-0 mt-1">
          <li><code>admin</code> - <span>{{ __('LOGIN.DEMO_ADMIN') }}</span></li>
          <li><code>pelissier</code>, <code>tatou</code>, <code>dupont</code> - <span>{{ __('LOGIN.DEMO_DOCTOR') }}</span></li>
          <li><code>martin</code>, <code>durand</code>, <code>bistrou</code>, <code>german</code> - <span>{{ __('LOGIN.DEMO_USER') }}</span></li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
@endsection

The login form, a standard [<form>], is sent as POST to [/login].

  • Lines 22–23: The entered username is redisplayed after a failed login attempt ([$login]). The [autofocus] attribute places the cursor in the first field to be filled in: the username if it is empty, or the password otherwise (after a failed attempt or after creating an account);
  • line 31: the CAPTCHA;
  • lines 42–43: The “Create a Customer Account” button is not a link; it is a second button that submits the same form to a different address (button attribute [formaction]). The server verifies the CAPTCHA there before opening the account creation page ([InscriptionController::acces]). [formnovalidate]: The browser does not require a username and password (attributes [required]), as they are not needed to create an account. Pressing the Enter key in a field always triggers the first form submission button: Log In.

The day is a [type="date"] field: the browser displays a calendar and sends the date in [aaaa-mm-jj] format, regardless of how it displays it ([26/09/2026] in French);
  • lines 37–42: for a patient who already has an upcoming appointment, why there is no “Book” button;
  • lines 66–72: the slot status: Available (in green), the patient’s name (in blue for the appointment of the logged-in patient, in gray otherwise), or “Booked.” The view does not make any decisions: [$ligne->patient] is only populated if the user has permission to view that name;

  • lines 82–91: “Cancel” modifies data: it is a POST form (example 21), with its anti-CSRF token, the appointment to be canceled, and information to return to the same page (the doctor, the day). The [data-confirmation] attribute causes the page’s script to request confirmation;

Browser validators are merely a convenience that anyone can bypass; disabling them here allows you to see the server’s messages;

/* =========================================================================
   public/css/styles.css - quelques réglages en plus de Bootstrap
   (les mêmes que dans les autres versions de cette application).
   ========================================================================= */

body {
  background-color: #f5f7fa;
}

.creneau-libre:hover {
  background-color: #e9f7ef;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   .zone-erreur : les messages d'erreur, en bas de page, sur fond rose léger
   (cf. resources/views/fragments/erreurs.blade.php).
   position: sticky + bottom : si la page est plus haute que la fenêtre (un
   agenda de 12 créneaux, par exemple), la zone reste collée au bas de la
   fenêtre au lieu de disparaître sous la ligne de flottaison - sans jamais
   recouvrir le contenu quand la page est courte.
   z-index : au-dessus du fond grisé de la fenêtre de réservation (.modal-backdrop).
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.zone-erreur {
  position: sticky;
  bottom: 1rem;
  z-index: 1060;
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  background-color: #fdecef; /* light pink */
  border: 1px solid #f5c2c7;

[position: sticky] with [bottom: 1rem]: if the page is taller than the window (a calendar with 12 time slots), the area remains anchored to the bottom of the window instead of disappearing below the scroll bar; if the page is short, it stays in place without covering anything. [z-index]: It appears over the gray background of the booking window;
